review:
The Norse goddess on a 6x7 tumbling grid with a lives-based respin. The Freya Super Symbol lands on the bottom row as a wild and gives respins, with wilds carrying random lives – each respin after a tumble uses one up.

A Redrop symbol can clear the reels and counts as a tumble. The bonus triggers on five tumble wins in a row – no scatters needed – and a wheel sets the spins and minimum ways first. Up to 8,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
